member.name: T:TrueAutomation.UnitTesting.NHibernate.LiveRepositoryTest
member.summary: Implements a base class for repository nunit-based unit tests against a live database that exists outside of the test environment. This class wraps all its operations in a transaction that is rolled back at the end of the test so that any changes made during the test are not persisted permanently to the database.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.UnitTesting.NHibernate.LiveRepositoryTest.SetUp
member.summary: An NUnit-based setup method for performing unit test setup. This method initializes the gloabl NHibernate session manager using the information in the app.config file and any accompanying nhibernate.cfg.xml file to identify the settings for the underlying database. It then starts a new transaction that will span the lifetime of the test so that any changes can be rolled back in the eventual teardown.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.UnitTesting.NHibernate.LiveRepositoryTest.TearDown
member.summary: Implements a standard NUnit-style teardown method to shut down the global NHibernate session manager when the unit test is complete. This method rolls back the transaction used by this test class so that any changes performed by the test will not actually be written to the persistent data store.

member.name: T:TrueAutomation.UnitTesting.NHibernate.MemoryRepositoryTestBase
member.summary: Implements a base class for repository nunit-based unit tests using a transient database created and populated dynamically at runtime.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.UnitTesting.NHibernate.MemoryRepositoryTestBase.SetUp
member.summary: An NUnit-based setup method for performing unit test setup. This method initializes the gloabl NHibernate session manager using the information in the app.config file and any accompanying nhibernate.cfg.xml file to identify the settings for the underlying database. It then invokes the LoadData() method to load any data required for the test.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.UnitTesting.NHibernate.MemoryRepositoryTestBase.TearDown
member.summary: Implements a standard NUnit-style teardown method to shut down the global NHibernate session manager when the unit test is complete.
